instruction: Make an <a> anchor with text "Google" that redirects to https://www.google.com when clicked

correct.title: Perfect! 🎉
correct.details: You've created a proper link! The <a> tag with href attribute connects to Google. Great job!

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details:
